halfLife.notes: Once- or twice-daily oral dosing typical. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

activeMetabolite.name: Reduced haloperidol
activeMetabolite.notes: Reduced haloperidol can be re-oxidised to parent and contribute mildly to exposure but not considered clinically dominant. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

cypInteractions.switchingRelevance: CYP2D6 inhibitors raise haloperidol levels and worsen EPS. CYP3A4 inducers (carbamazepine) reduce levels. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

metabolicRisk.notes: Minimal metabolic burden — historically a reason FGAs persist for some patient profiles despite EPS risk. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

lai.notes: Haldol Decanoate (4-weekly). Long-established LAI option but EPS and tardive risk on chronic use are notable. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

reboundPsychosisRisk.notes: Standard relapse risk on abrupt cessation. Less anticholinergic rebound than olanzapine. Withdrawal dyskinesia possible after long-term use. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

formulationNotes: Tablets and IM injection (acute use). QTc check at baseline and on dose increases above 5 mg/day is prudent. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
